mapper.select: SELECT m.table_name, m.model_name, f.field_code, f.field_name, f.column_type FROM gen_dynamic_model m LEFT JOIN gen_dynamic_field f ON f.model_id = m.id AND f.tenant_id = m.tenant_id AND f.deleted = 0 WHERE m.tenant_id = #{tenantId} AND m.deleted = 0 AND m.status = 'PUBLISHED' ORDER BY m.id, f.sort_no, f.id
